subject.title: fix(tui): keep skill approvals in the terminal

question: Should TUI-originated plugin approvals stop using configured messaging-channel fallback and be reviewed only in the initiating terminal session?
rationale: That behavior is the intended bug fix, but it changes an existing fallback path that some users may rely on for remote Telegram-style approval review.

options.title: Accept TUI-scoped approvals after proof
options.body: Mark the draft ready once exact-head proof covers Gateway TUI, embedded local, reconnect/gap refresh, and unchanged exec approval forwarding.

options.title: Preserve channel fallback
options.body: Revise the PR so terminal-local approval is primary but configured messaging-channel fallback remains available for users who depend on it.

options.title: Pause for approval UX design
options.body: Hold or close this branch if maintainers decide plugin approvals need a broader cross-surface approval model before changing delivery semantics.

recommendation.title: Accept TUI-scoped approvals after proof
recommendation.body: Mark the draft ready once exact-head proof covers Gateway TUI, embedded local, reconnect/gap refresh, and unchanged exec approval forwarding.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR author is also the recent approval/TUI area contributor and issue owner for the linked maintainer report.
